headline: PLAVE take 3-week break, back Dec 14
sub: Members will rest and work on their next album
source: Source: Official notice from VLAST via Korean media
caption:
PLAVE are taking a three-week break and will be back on Dec 14.

VLAST announced on the official fan platform that after wrapping the 2026 world tour 'KEEP IT MANIC' and 'HYPERDRIVE' promotions, Yejun, Noah, Bamby, Eunho and Hamin will rest while preparing their next album. Regular live streams and content return Dec 14, and 'Live with Members' will continue during the break. The agency said they'll come back "healthier and looking great."

📌 Source: VLAST official notice, via Korean media (TenAsia, iMBC)
